answer: A state childcare license proves a real caregiver. It is issued only after an in-person safety inspection and staff background checks, and its number is verified against the public registry, one license per inspected address, with a fresh inspection each renewal. An honest operator pays $200 a year plus one morning; 1,000 fake identities need $200,000 in forged licenses plus 1,000 fake inspections, while delta auditors, ferrous inspectors and forge clerks each verify a different part for free.
